# Lavendar Lewis

[Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge)

- **Age:** presumed 45  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P48](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0048), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P58](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0058)</sub>

## Appearance

Lavendar Lewis is a sweet and pretty lady with a fresh, almost girlish face and big, wood-brown eyes that feature little golden glints. Her thick, snow-white hair is beautifully wavy and carefully arranged in becoming puffs and coils. Over time, her appearance remains unchanged except to grow even sweeter and prettier.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P58](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0058), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v3 ch.Again P58](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0058), [v3 ch.People P3](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0003)_

## Personality

Lavendar Lewis relies heavily on her imagination to cope with life's difficulties. Since an earlier point, she has maintained a strong habit of pretending and creating ideal scenarios to sustain herself through tough times.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057)_

## History

Lavendar Lewis lived at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with her young maid, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), named by her father after lavender because he loved its scent. After getting lost on a walk, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) met Miss Lavendar, and a quiet sadness came over her when [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally mentioned [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). Miss Lavendar later opened up to [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her past romance and broken engagement with Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to introduce young [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) to her, and the two quickly formed a warm connection. After [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) returned to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne.md) helped arrange a reunion at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) that resulted in [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) and Miss Lavendar reconciling. [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) subsequently helped Miss Lavendar prepare for her wedding, and she married [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) in her garden before departing, leaving [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) temporarily closed. Following her marriage, she later hosted [Anne](../character/anne.md) for a summer visit, gently questioning her about her disrupted relationship with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P6](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0006), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P11](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0011), +341 more_

## Quotes

> "But oh, won’t you stay and have tea with me? Please, do. Mr. Kimball’s will have tea over before you get there. And Charlotta the Fourth and I will be so glad to have you."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)

> "It gave me a shock to hear about Stephen’s son that first day you were here, Anne. I’ve never been able to mention him to you since, but I’ve wanted to know all about him. What sort of a boy is he?"
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P21](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0021)

> "Oh, I’m not so old as I thought . . . and I don’t need a single blue pill! Girls, when you come back with your strawberries we’ll have tea out here under the silver poplar. I’ll have it all ready for you with home-grown cream."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P36](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0036)

> "About your age I think. He ought to be older because I dreamed him long before you were born. But I’ll never let him get any older than eleven or twelve; because if I did some day he might grow up altogether and then I’d lose him."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P61](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0061)

> "I’m wholesomely ashamed to think that a new dress . . . even it is a forget-me-not organdy . . . should exhilarate me so, when a good conscience and an extra contribution to Foreign Missions couldn’t do it."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P19](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0019)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--lavendar-lewis.md)

Miss Lavendar meets [Anne](../character/anne.md) when [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) accidentally lose their way in the woods and arrive at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). The two quickly bond over shared tea, stories, and their imaginative spirits, forming a deep, intimate friendship. [Anne](../character/anne.md) acts as a confidante regarding Lavendar's past romance and helps orchestrate her reunion with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), while Lavendar later offers gentle advice on Anne's own romantic dilemmas.

- Friend of — very dear intimate friends and kindred spirits  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P32](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0032), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), +2 more</sub>

### [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

[Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) serves as the young maid at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) under Miss Lavendar's employment. [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) cares deeply for her mistress, openly expressing concern for Lavendar's melancholy moods to their visitors. She actively assists Lavendar and [Anne](../character/anne.md) with hostings, outings, and preparations for Lavendar's eventual wedding.

- Commands — employer  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), +4 more</sub>

### [Diana](../character/diana.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana--lavendar-lewis.md)

[Diana](../character/diana.md) first encounters Miss Lavendar when she and [Anne](../character/anne.md) wander off course on their way to a tea party and discover [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). [Diana](../character/diana.md) becomes a regular, welcome guest who brings life to Lavendar's home during playful gatherings and pretend tea parties. She later returns to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to assist Lavendar and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) with the preparations for Lavendar's wedding.

- Friend of — frequent visitors who brought joy to her life  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003)</sub>

### [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fourth--lavendar-lewis.md)

[Fourth](../character/fourth.md) serves as Miss Lavendar's young household maid at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Lavendar employs and directs her around the home and garden.

- Commands  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>

### [Irving](../character/irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/irving--lavendar-lewis.md)

Miss Lavendar reunites with her former romance after years apart, rekindling their courtship and ultimately marrying him in a garden ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Following their wedding, they embark on married life together while continuing to visit [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) during summer breaks.

- Romantically involved with — taking a walk together while courting  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012)</sub>
- Spouse of — fiancé/husband  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P4](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0004), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), [v3 ch.Change P2](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0002)</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--paul-irving.md)

Miss Lavendar meets [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) after [Anne](../character/anne.md) introduces the boy to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), and the two instantly connect over their shared, vivid imaginations. Lavendar sits with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) in her garden to trade stories, finding that her tales of her imaginary dream-boy resonate deeply with his own fanciful mind. They remain fond companions through her courtship with his father, [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md).

- Friend of — kindred spirits sharing stories and imagination in the garden  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051)</sub>

### [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--stephen-irving.md)

[Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) is Miss Lavendar's former fiancé from a broken engagement twenty-five years prior. After [Anne](../character/anne.md) helps arrange a surprise reunion at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), the long-separated lovers reconcile, resume their courtship, and are eventually married in a garden ceremony before departing together.

- Romantically involved with — formerly engaged twenty-five years ago  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- Spouse of — married in a ceremony  <sub>[v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030)</sub>
